name: Hoshiask
tagline: A help desk for organisations with field offices: a client portal and a staff console.
summary: Clients file tickets in their own portal. Staff assign, answer, escalate, merge and close them, with SLA reminders, a knowledge base, reports and a full audit trail.

features: Clients file and follow tickets in their own portal; staff work them in a separate console.
Tickets move from Open to Closed or Cancelled, with several assignees, escalation and merging of duplicates.
Public replies and internal notes share one thread, and clients only ever see the public side.
SLA reminders, and stale tickets close or cancel themselves after a warning.
Monthly and custom reports, CSV and PDF export, and saved ticket views.
An audit trail, consent tracking and a clean-up that removes personal details from old tickets.

build.title: The office lives on the ticket
build.body: Each ticket stores its own field office, so reports stay right when a client moves or their account is deleted.

build.title: Privacy that keeps the numbers
build.body: The clean-up removes names and contact details but keeps the ticket row, so past reports and response times never change.

build.title: One clock for every SLA
build.body: Every cut-off goes through one business-hours clock that can count around the clock or only working hours.

build.title: No inline scripts
build.body: A strict Content Security Policy, made possible by Alpine's CSP build. Backups are encrypted with AES-256-GCM and can be verified and restored.

build.title: Tested on two databases
build.body: 1,182 PHPUnit tests run on SQLite and again on PostgreSQL 16, with 105 Vitest tests and 20 Playwright tests that include axe accessibility checks.

nodes.name: Clients
nodes.detail: Report a problem, follow its progress and reply, in their own part of the site.

nodes.name: Staff
nodes.detail: Take on problems, answer them, pass urgent ones up, and see reports.

nodes.name: The Hoshiask website
nodes.detail: One website with two sides: one for clients and one for staff. A single clock decides when each reply is due, counting office hours only or the whole day.

nodes.name: Timed jobs
nodes.detail: Run every minute: send reminders, close old tickets, and back everything up each night.

nodes.name: Email sender
nodes.detail: Sends the emails in the background, so no page ever waits for them.

nodes.name: Database
nodes.detail: Keeps every ticket, every office and a record of every change.

nodes.name: Email
nodes.detail: Delivers ticket updates to clients and reminders to staff.

nodes.name: File storage
nodes.detail: Keeps attachments and the nightly backups, locked with encryption.
